study_identification_part.si_4_title: Microstructural mapping of neural pathways in Alzheimer's disease using macrostructure-informed normative tractometry

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ADNI-3: 730 participants from North America across 7 acquisition protocols (S31, S55, S127, P33, P36, GE36, GE54); NIMHANS: 302 Indian-ancestry participants from National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences in Bangalore, India, scanned at two scanners (Philips 3T Ingenia and Siemens 3T Skyra); TractoInferno: 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from publicly available training dataset used for pretraining.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "In total, we analyzed diffusion data of 1032 subjects from two cohorts - 730 participants from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) Phase 3 collected using seven acquisition protocols and an independent sample of 302 Indian-ancestry participants, evaluated and scanned at two scanners at the National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS) in Bangalore, India." ... "In our study, this pretraining dataset consisted of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes already preprocessed from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Methods / Participant demographics, L77; Methods / TractoInferno, L126-128

answer.ADNI-3: normative model training (35% CN), validation (15% CN), and testing (50% CN plus MCI and dementia) for MINT framework

answer.NIMHANS: normative model training (35% CN), validation (15% CN), and testing (50% CN plus MCI and dementia) for MINT framework - analyzed separately from ADNI

answer.TractoInferno: pretraining dataset for VAE model to encode normal variation in DTI measures and tract geometry

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: TractoInferno was used to pretrain the VAE model. For both ADNI and NIMHANS, CN participants were split 35%/15%/50% for training/validation/testing. MCI and dementia participants were added to the 50% CN test set. Models were fine-tuned separately for each cohort.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "For both the ADNI and NIMHANS datasets, data from the CN participants were split into independent subsets of size 35%/15%/50% for training/validation/testing. Data from participants with MCI or dementia were concatenated with the 50% CN subjects to create the test set." ... "The pretrained VAE model was fine-tuned on 30 bundles from the subjects in the training set, in each cohort, for 5000 steps. We did not pool the training data in ADNI and NIMHANS together in this step"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Methods / Data preparation and training, L167-168

model-1.train-phase: 200 inferred (ADNI 35% of 447 ≈ 157 + NIMHANS 35% of 123 ≈ 43); plus 198 from TractoInferno for pretraining

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: One normative model was built using a VAE-based approach. TractoInferno (198 healthy adults) was used for pretraining. For the target datasets, CN participants were used: ADNI had 447 CN and NIMHANS had 123 CN. 35% of CN from each cohort was used for fine-tuning (training), 15% for validation, and 50% for testing. Train phase calculation: ADNI 447 × 0.35 ≈ 157, NIMHANS 123 × 0.35 ≈ 43, total ≈ 200 for fine-tuning. Pretraining used all 198 TractoInferno subjects.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "The subset of the ADNI cohort that was scanned with dMRI consisted of 447 cognitively normal (CN) participants, 214 diagnosed with MCI, and 69 with dementia." ... "The NIMHANS cohort consisted of dMRI data from 123 CN participants, 89 people with MCI, and 90 with dementia." ... "data from the CN participants were split into independent subsets of size 35%/15%/50% for training/validation/testing"
